issue.body:
I had a case where I was redirecting from a POST /token endpoint to the GET /docs endpoint. The redirectresponse `response = RedirectResponse(url=redirect_url)` was using the same http method POST for the redirect url /docs as was used for the /token endpoint.  After adding another decorator for @router.post("/docs") to the endpoint (in addition to @router.get("/docs"), it started working again.  Without it, I was getting the '405 Method not allowed' error. I didn't see any way of setting the method in the RedirectResponse. 

Starlette == 0.12.7  (FastAPI 0.36.0)
issue.title: RedirectResponse http method leakage?
